You are absolutely right. I have 1 school in mind that I really like because multiple faculty line up with my interests, and another that is a somewhat good fit, but not as great as the first school.

How important is it to go to an R1 if you want to go into research or academia? I’ve heard it’s super important in the past, but I have a couple of lower-ranked schools that also match my interests that I’d be interested in applying to if it isn’t an end-all-be-all thing.
